outline.description: Section-by-section outline mirroring the deliverable's structure (essay: intro/body/conclusion; report: exec summary/methodology/findings/recommendations; code: module breakdown with TODO stubs).

bullets.description: What the student should cover in this section.

starter_draft_markdown.description: 300-600 words of opening content in Markdown. Enough to break the blank page, NOT a finished submission. Use [STUDENT TO EXPAND: ...] for the rest and [CITE: <what to look for>] instead of inventing citations.

disclaimer.description: Fixed disclaimer string. Must always be present and non-empty.
